thread_text:
raja: Quick sync on v2.3.1 RN/internal announce. Change window Wed 23:00 UTC. Need short blurb, deploybot commands, pin header, and rollback bullets. Who can own blast?

nina: Ill draft the internal blurb and RN bullets. Will post link in ~30m.

lee: Canary plan: 10% 20m -> 50% 20m -> 100% 20m. Health gates: error_rate > 1.5% (5m) OR p95 + 100ms => pause. OOM_count > 0 = immediate pause+rollback.

juan: Add Dedicated note: customers can pin runtime with header `x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f`. We'll offer a migration window.

deploybot: Scheduled: v2.3.1 start=2024-11-06T23:00:00Z. Command: `/deploy v2.3.1 --canary=10% --stages=50%,100% --stage-duration=20m`

opsbot: Automation rules saved for this deploy: error_rate > 1.5% (5m), p95_delta > 100ms (5m), oom_count > 0 (2m). Auto-rollback if two conditions fire.

nina: Draft posted: https://rwd.internal/releases/drafts/v2.3.1-brief  please review. I'll post internal announce 20m before window unless objections.

raja: Add one-line ops checklist in RN with copy/paste commands (pause, rollback, pin).

lee: Ops snippets for RN: 
`/deploybot pause --id {{deploy_id}}`
`/deploybot rollback --to v2.3.0`
`curl -H "x-rw-runtime: rif-runtime@3c7f" https://api.redwood.ai/health`

nina: Added SDK examples and dedicated header instructions. Also included brief testing notes: staging smoke + quant regression checks.

juan: I'll be oncall during the window.

raja: Staging smoke now; will report in 10m. If green, Nina can send blast.

deploybot: Canary started (10%)  monitoring hooks active. Good luck! :rocket:
